btc.title: ₿ Bitcoin — 🟡 NEUTRAL, confidence LOW
btc.text: Only 4 of 8 lenses are fresh. The 2× Macro lens stays neutral but is the strongest it has been: spot ETFs took in $524.8M on 10/21 ($1.07B over three sessions, +$911.7M over seven), the dollar eased to 101.64 and Fear & Greed rose to 63. The lone bullish lens, Woo on-chain, rests on undated Newhedge prints that jumped implausibly overnight and is half-weighted. Below $80,000 puts $75K and Brandt's $65–66K warning in play; a close above $84,808 on continued inflows eases pressure.
